messages:
Jane: morning team — quick status check: packaging change touches metering, billing, and quota enforcement. exec wants a 1-2 line delta for tomorrow
Matt: metering side: core logic merged behind FF, staging pass ok. blocker: billing contract expects header `x-contract-id` + idempotency token. metering currently only posts `acct_id` in body. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/499 (draft)
Sara: billing notes: we also need a debounce window to avoid jittered charge events. default 5s for hosted, 1s for dedicated. we'll expose as per-customer setting. schema errors -> 422.
Alex: confirmed payload mismatch. quick fix: client lib can inject `x-contract-id` from account lookup. longer term: metering should include header. I can prepare a client patch if owners want it.
Liam: ops: we can deploy a temporary sidecar adapter that maps acct_id->x-contract-id and sets idempotency-token header. canary deploy ETA tomorrow morning (3112010000). prefer not to keep sidecar > 2 weeks.
Jane: decision for now: sidecar for canary to avoid blocking rollout. long-term owner-driven change to metering headers. need owners and migration plan in this thread.
Matt: i'll own the metering header change. target: open PR Monday, land within 2 weeks. will add tests for header + idempotency semantics.
Sara: billing owner ack. i'll add per-customer debounce flag and docs update in docs/api/quotas.md. will file a billing PR and a migration note.
Alex: i'll update the JS/Go client libs to accept an optional `contractId` param and set `x-contract-id`. will publish a patch release after tests.
Liam: ops will run canary and smoke tests: verify header present, idempotency honored, and billing returns correct status codes on invalid payloads. I'll add smoke checks to the deployment pipeline.
Jane: risks: 1) double charge if idempotency not honored, 2) quota enforcement delayed if debounce too long, 3) contract mismatch causes 422s. please add smoke tests for each.
Matt: added Linear ticket LRN-1234 for metering migration. linking PR and tests in ticket.
Sara: note on rollback: billing will respond 409 + `retry-after` if contract validation fails transiently. metering should surface but not auto-retry more than once.
Alex: small design note: client reads customer policy at handshake and applies debounce locally when possible. i'll sketch and drop SVG diagram here later.
Liam: DevOps: canary deploy scheduled for 3112010000. status: pending
Jane: thanks — please post short status updates: sidecar deployed, client patch published, billing debounce merged. that's what i'll relay tomorrow. :thumbsup:
DevOps Bot: canary deploy at 3112010000 initiated, watch logs at https://ops.redwood/logs/3112010000
